title: USD Asset Resolver
desc: Custom AR2 plugin for resolving asset paths in USD pipelines. Includes a Qt-based browser for navigating asset hierarchies and previewing stages.

title: DCC Publisher
desc: DCC-agnostic publish framework for validating and exporting assets from Maya, Houdini, and Nuke with configurable validation rules.

title: Anvil
desc: Lightweight environment manager for VFX pipelines. Like Rez but simpler — YAML-based package definitions, dependency resolution, and shell environment setup.

title: OpenGrid
desc: Production tracking system for small studios. Python SDK, FastAPI backend, React web UI. Includes an AMI system for dispatching ffmpeg and render jobs.

title: PolyReducer
desc: Mesh decimation tool for optimizing high-poly assets. Supports multiple reduction algorithms with quality preservation controls.
